column1: # Issue #1429: small functions of Reverb_x64.dll that the DLL reaches only through a pointer in its data (a 16-byte table of {function, 0} at RVA 0x628d0,
# a table of code pointers at RVA 0x61908, and others), and that have no .pdata entry, so the lift does not find them. Without them the engine stops at the
# first call through one of them ("indirect call to 0xcbb7ef0 is not a known function entry": RVA 0x17ef0, the first entry of the table at RVA 0x628d0).
# Found by reading the 8-byte values of .rdata and .data that point into .text: 88 such values, 33 of them not a .pdata start, 28 distinct RVAs. Each RVA
# was checked by its bytes (a short function that starts after a return, an int3 or a zero byte of padding). plugins.rs turns each row into a VA at the
# DLL's base and passes the file to the lift and to the wasm generator (--seeds).
